Title: Shatter the Gate and Army of Apparition

Messages.Author: kleberjf
Messages.Body:
Hi,

Can I use Army os Apparitin to cause to fail a D action to burn shatter the gate?

Tks,

Kleber.

Army of Apparitions
Type: Reaction
Requires: Chimerstry
Usable by a tapped vampire.
[chi] Only usable during a referendum. Gain 3 votes.
[CHI] Only usable when an ally or younger vampire is taking a  action directed at a minion you control. This vampire burns 2 blood to cause the action to end (unsuccessfully).

Shatter the Gate
Type: Action
Requires: infernal,capacity 9 Baali
+1 stealth action. Requires an infernal Baali with capacity 9 or more.
Put this card on this Baali. A vampire with capacity 6 or more may burn the Edge to burn this card as a  action. If this Baali has three Shatter the Gates, burn them all to give each other Methuselah a shattered counter. A Methuselah with any shattered counters burns 3 pool during his or her untap phase. Burn option.

Messages.Author: Haze
Messages.Body:
No

Shatter the Gate is not a minion.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
The action is targeting the Shatter the Gate not targeting the minion (same reasoning behind being able to Rampage a Secure Haven when you can't rush the vampire).

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418
